This app uses the data created with the standalone application Relations RCP (https://sourceforge.net/projects/relations-rcp/).\nFirst you have to synchronize (i.e. download) the data. To do that, configure the Cloud Configuration (in Settings) and start a full synchronize (in Synchronize Database).
After data synchronization, the items are displayed in a list. To display an item’s details, swipe the item to the left.
To display the items related to the actual entry, swipe the details page to the left.
To search for an item, enter the search term in the search field.\nNote: the fulltext search index must be created in the language of your items (see Settings -> Language).

Relations 2.0.0
• Requires Android 6.0 or newer.
• Google Drive is no longer supported. If you synchronized with Google Drive, upload your Relations export to Dropbox or Microsoft Azure and select that provider in Settings → Cloud Configuration.
• Updated for Android 16: edge-to-edge display and the predictive back gesture.
• More reliable data synchronization.
